caseName: Prudence Co. v. Fidelity & Deposit Co.
caseNameFull: Prudence Co., Inc. v. Fidelity & Deposit Co.
attorneys: Mr. Alfred T. Davison for petitioner., Messrs. John W. Davis and Joseph F. Murray for respondents.
